title: Porch Time Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS - Access to Gulf Place Cabanas shared pools, hot tub, tennis courts, bike and paddle board rentals, and outdoor grill in common area - Breathtaking ocean view from the balcony - 4th floor, no one above you to wake you up walking in the morning - 2 adult sized beach cruisers included - Walking distance to several shops and restaurants - Community grill - Wifi and streaming TVs - Fully stocked kitchen - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ON: **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($50 fee applies at booking). Kick back, relax, and enjoy beach living at it's finest when you stay at one of the best gulf front condos along 30a! "Porch Time" is a 1.5 bedroom condo located at Gulf Place Cabana's along the Emerald Coast. The beautiful decor offers serene paint colors, Smart TV, free WiFi, and so much more! Located on the 4th floor, "Porch Time" has an open living and dining space that seats 6 comfortably. Extra seating in the living room with Smart TV, a fully equipped kitchen, and sliding glass doors out to the best seats in the house! Aptly named Porch Time, you are sure to spend your mornings and afternoons watching the sun rise and set over the beautiful Gulf of Mexico! Gulf Place community is right below offering an array of boutique shopping, ice cream shop, great restaurants, pharmacy, coffee shop, Pilates studio, spa, and an open green space for outdoor concerts and entertainment. You're sure to enjoy your time along 30a when you stay at "Porch Time" in Gulf Place! ACCOMMODATIONS (sleeps 4) Bedroom 1: Master Suite- King bed ,flat screen TV, and private bath/shower combo. A built-in bunk area offers 2 more places for people to rest their heads and a half bath completes this space offering the extra vanity space for 4 to stay comfortably! ** Please note there is no washer/dryer in the condo unit, but there is a shared laundry facility on the same floor as the condo.** ** SPECIAL NOTE- This property requires a 6-7 night rental for the week of July 2- 9. ** FREE WiFi Amenities Attractions Cinemas Live theater Restaurants Leisure Activities Beachcombing Outlet shopping Local Services And Businesses ATM/bank Babysitter Groceries Hospital Location Type Beach Beach View Beachfront Lake View Near The Ocean Ocean View Oceanfront Water View Waterfront Outside Balcony Sports And Adventure Activities Deepsea fishing Golf Surfing Swimming Suitability Children welcome Non smoking only Pets not allowed Safety Outdoor lighting Deadbolt lock on entryway Smoke detectors Carbon monoxide detector Fire extinguisher Health And Safety Enhanced cleaning practices Clean with disinfectant No-contact check-in and check-out High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF Kitchen Full Kitchen Refrigerator Coffee Maker Microwave Toaster Cookware Blender Living Air Conditioning Ceiling Fans Ironing Board Outdoor Balcony Shared Pool Tennis Shared Outdoor Grill Entertainment Cable TV DVD Player WiFi 2 Bikes Included Smart TV Beach Town Beach Town -
